# JEWELSETU (Jewelsetu Quality Management Services)
> Independent third-party jewellery quality assurance, pre-shipment inspection, factory 
auditing, and Total Quality Management (TQM) consultancy based in Jaipur, India.
## About JEWELSETU & Founder
- **Company Name:** JEWELSETU (Jewelsetu Quality Consultancy / Jewelsetu QMS)
- **Website:** https://www.jewelsetuqms.in
- **Location:** Jaipur, Rajasthan, India (Serving Jaipur, Mumbai, Delhi, and international 
buying houses across North America, Europe, and the UK)
- **Founder & Principal Consultant:** Sanket Shrivastava
- **Credentials & Experience:**
  - 18+ years of leadership experience in jewellery manufacturing operations, TQM, and 
international quality compliance.
  - Former India Q.C. Head at Juwelo TV (Germany) [2020–2025].
  - Former QA Manager at Melorra and 13 years in QA leadership (Deputy Manager) at GemsTV UK 
(Gemporia).
  - Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt & Green Belt (Otifas Institute), TQM Certified, GIA 
Diamond Graduate, and GJSCI Certified Assessor.
## Core Services
1. **Third-Party Jewellery Quality Inspections (PSI / DUPRO):**
   - ISO 2859 AQL sampling and 100% piece-by-piece inspections.
   - Stage-wise floor-to-floor checks: CAD/CAM, casting, filing, diamond & gemstone setting, 
polishing, plating, and final assembly.
   - Gemstone treatment detection and diamond grading verification.
2. **Supplier & Factory Quality Audits:**
   - Technical capability assessments, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), CAPA implementation, and 
SOP engineering.
   - Regulatory and ethical compliance readiness: BIS Hallmarking, RJC (Responsible 
Jewellery Council), and SBTi standards.
3. **Monthly QMS Retainers & Defect Reduction:**
   - Dedicated on-site quality system setup, Job Master Cards, porosity acceptance 
standards, and QC team calibration training.
   - Proven track record of reducing casting defects from >40% to under 5% and lowering 
overall repair rates.
4. **JEWELSETU Q-TRACK Portal:**
   - Proprietary cloud-based QC management system featuring real-time inspector GPS check-
in/out, bulk SKU job cards, hold-for-approval workflows, and automated photo-backed 
inspection reports.
